BeginOAuthApplicationsRead.reason: Decodes only the oauthApplications field of the retained installed logical source (BeginInstalledMetadataRead: exact installed generation, unpinned, work-admitted), keeping source order and nil versus empty; the read owns the decoded value until Close. Trusted lookup only; the route authorization and the API key admin-scope filter stay in the caller. Off mode refuses (callers keep their literal accessor). Covered by TestAPIKeyAndMCPSettingsRoutes legacy vs warm vs SQL-reloaded.
BeginOAuthApplicationsRead.temperatureReason: Backs the HOT OAuth application settings reads.
